name: trusted_fetch
description: Discover, call, and locally verify external data through AirnodeHub. Use when an agent needs current ETH/USD data with explicit provenance, freshness, signer, payment policy, and a portable evidence receipt.

intent.description: The external data needed, in plain language. This MVP supports the current USD price of ETH.

allowPaidCalls.description: This demo never creates or signs a payment authorization.
